scope: Lower-dimensional Oracle scheduling only, including conditional full-scene runs.
authorization: User asks faster execution without changing effects/task; discretionary early stopping remains separate.
request_order: Same frozen pool index per case; stop immediately at first success. No speculative later candidate execution.
numerical_entrypoint: The unchanged runner.work(request), original acceleration loader and recording-only adapter.
known_results: Resolve official exact and already-certified semantic reuse before scheduling. Register/preflight potential candidates; unexecuted potential candidates remain unknown.
parallelism: One CPU per worker; global18CPU including coordinator; UID and group locks prevent duplicate work.
merger: Only coordinator invokes official merger after workers exit; every consumed source row is read back.
infra_retries: At most4array submissions per cap, initial plus3retries; completed UIDs retained.
expected_benefit: Avoid a separate Slurm startup/barrier per eta frontier; actual saving measured after execution, not inferred as an already observed speedup.
